title: SmartWithdraw
description: SmartWithdraw is a lightweight Vault-integrated Minecraft economy plugin that allows players to convert virtual money into physical banknotes and redeem them back into their account.
body:
#  SmartWithdraw

**Turn any balance into physical, tradeable notes — securely.**

> ⚠️ **Requires an economy plugin.** Vault alone does nothing on its own — you also need an economy plugin like **EssentialsX** installed and enabled for Money withdrawals to work. If you see a "Vault not found" error, this is almost always why.
>
> 📥 [**Vault**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) · [**EssentialsX**](https://essentialsx.net/)

SmartWithdraw lets your players withdraw their balance as real, holdable items — pass them around, store them in chests, trade them hand-to-hand — and deposit them back whenever they like. Built with anti-dupe security at its core, so your economy stays safe.

---

## ✨ Features

**🔐 Tamper-Proof Notes**
Every note is cryptographically signed. No plugin, NBT editor, or exploit can forge a fake note — forged or edited items are automatically rejected.

**💵 Multiple Balance Types**
Withdraw from more than just your economy plugin:
- **Money** — via Vault / EssentialsX
- **GamePoints** — via PlayerPoints
- **Experience** — straight from player XP/levels, no extra plugin needed

**📄 Flexible Denominations**
Choose exactly how withdrawals work:
- Get one exact-value note per withdrawal, *or*
- Auto-split into the fewest real notes possible (e.g. withdraw 2500 → get a 2000 + a 500)

**✂️ Manual Note Splitting**
Sneak + left-click any note to break it into smaller denominations on the spot — no need to redeposit and re-withdraw.

**🎨 Fully Configurable Aesthetics**
Every currency gets its own name, symbol, color, and tooltip style. Rename "Satchel" to whatever fits your server's theme, set your own tax display, tier labels, and branding.

**🖱️ Simple, Intuitive Interactions**
- Right-click a note → deposit it
- Sneak + right-click a stack → deposit it all at once
- `/deposit` → deposit every valid note in your inventory, across all currencies, in one command

**🏦 Built-in Bank GUI**
`/sw gui` opens a clean menu to withdraw specific denominations, deposit everything, and switch between currencies — no commands needed.

**🛠️ Admin Tools**
- `/sw give <player> <amount> [currency]` — hand out notes directly
- `/sw reload` — apply config changes without restarting
- `/sw currencies` — list everything configured

**📊 Transaction Logging**
Every withdrawal, deposit, and admin action gets logged with timestamp, player, currency, and amount — full audit trail included.

**🧩 PlaceholderAPI Support**
Show balances and held note values anywhere — scoreboards, tab lists, chat formats.

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Paper or Spigot, Minecraft 1.21+
- [**Vault**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) — required
- **A Vault-compatible economy plugin**, e.g. [**EssentialsX**](https://essentialsx.net/) — required for Money currency

**Optional:**
- [PlayerPoints](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/playerpoints.80745/) — for the GamePoints currency
- [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) — for placeholders

---

## ⚙️ Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/withdraw <amount> [currency]` | Withdraw balance as notes |
| `/deposit` | Deposit all valid notes in your inventory |
| `/sw gui` | Open the bank menu |
| `/sw currencies` | List configured currencies |
| `/sw give <player> <amount> [currency]` | *(admin)* Give notes to a player |
| `/sw reload` | *(admin)* Reload configuration |

---

*Every currency, denomination, note style, and message is configurable — make SmartWithdraw feel native to your server.*
